description: This file defines the interface for the CCSP Message Bus Service related to WiFi management, including function prototypes for engaging with the message bus, initialization, finalization, resource management, and signaling within the WiFi component.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_MessageBusEngage
methods.description: Initiates engagement with the message bus for the specified component, configuration, and path.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the WiFi MBI with provided user data.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_Finalize
methods.description: Finalizes and cleans up resources associated with the WiFi MBI.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_Buscheck
methods.description: Performs a check or poll on the message bus status.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_FreeResources
methods.description: Releases resources with a specified priority for the user data.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_SendParameterValueChangeSignal
methods.description: Sends a signal to notify change in parameter value.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_SendTransferCompleteSignal
methods.description: Signals the completion of a transfer.

methods.name: ssp_WifiMbi_RegisterToCR
methods.description: Registers to a configuration repository or control registry using a parameter array.

methods.name: waitConditionReady
methods.description: Waits until a communication condition or resource is ready between components.
